layout.irl: top 1920x920 (scale/crop the 16:9 source to 1920x920, keep heads; rotated 545: rotate upright, centre-crop to 1920x920 from the 4K original if available, else pillarbox on a blurred, darkened copy - no text there)

timing_note: timeline times are pre-beat-snap. Editor snaps each cut to the nearest music accent within +-0.15 s, moving the src_in/out of music-only shots first; never cut inside a sync word; match-cut src_out values are fixed (move src_in).

Legible: 542@16 00:03.00, 544@30 05:28.64, 545@56 08:32.23 STOPPED, 546@5 08:46.40, 547@66 11:17.36, 548@7 13:05.01, 551@30 15:31.30, 553@9 20:24.95. clock_model.display: MM:SS, truncated like a stopwatch. Each IRL event shows the true value for its own source frames, so the clock jumps forward at cuts (animate the jump as an 8-frame digit roll). Never run backwards. Scan inserts and cards hold the last value unless the event says otherwise.
